name: Rehana Mukherjee-Venkatesh
role: Information trader and intelligence analyst — broker
location: The Narrows — cramped residential corridors between megastructures, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Rehana Mukherjee-Venkatesh is wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 29, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon  — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, she worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. She works as a broker out of The Narrows, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Rehana Mukherjee-Venkatesh operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
blind_spots: Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
psychology.secret: Alper Castillo-Ababio is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
example_lines: "I don't sell information. I sell certainty. Different product, different price."
"Everything has a value. Most people underestimate what they know."
"My sources are confidential. My prices are not."

story_hooks: Alper Castillo-Ababio's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Alper Castillo-Ababio owes a personal debt to
Alper Castillo-Ababio is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Alper Castillo-Ababio functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon platform. Move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon platform
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Shelf circuit exclusively

weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
habits: Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about

physical_description.heritage: South Asian (52.2%), Sub-Saharan African (22.3%), East Asian (16.5%), and Northern European (9.0%) ancestry. Her genetic mix produces striking, unconventional beauty: deep warm brown skin with golden undertones from dominant South Asian and African heritage, harmonized with subtle East Asian and Northern European influences. South Asian cheekbone prominence and rounding blend with African facial geometry, East Asian eye shape, and Northern European jawline definition creating luminous, complex facial structure that defies singular regional classification.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean — minimal body fat, corded muscle from constant kinetic motion. Compact and efficient frame built for speed rather than power, augmented with move-by-wire leverage beyond natural physiology.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with faint blue-grey undertones from oxidized copper traces in the chrome beneath her scalp
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid, often wrapped with silver wire for both function and aesthetic
physical_description.hair_length: Medium — shoulder-length when loose, but typically secured
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones, reflecting dominant South Asian and Sub-Saharan African ancestry with subtle East Asian and Northern European influence creating luminous, complex complexion
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint silver striations in the iris — optical nerve interface reflections visible under direct light
physical_description.complexion: Strong, harmonized features — prominent cheekbones with gentle rounding characteristic of South Asian genetics, defined jawline refined by Northern European ancestry, warm-toned deep brown skin enriched by Sub-Saharan African heritage. Dark circles under eyes from nocturnal living. Clear skin with minor scarring at temples and jawline where move-by-wire harness integrates with nervous system. No makeup; exhaustion is a statement.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Full move-by-wire system visible as silver circuitry beneath translucent dermal panels on forearms, back of hands, and along neck. System pulses with blue-white electrochemical activity when in motion. Movements possess uncanny precision with no wasted gesture or biological tremor. Fingers move independently with servo-like control.
physical_description.posture_movement: Predatory stillness when stationary, coiled and ready. When moving, flows rather than walks — economical, precise, weightless. Head rotates on slightly inhuman axis. Unconscious habit of flexing fingers when thinking, watching chrome beneath skin respond to will.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional streetwear. Black fitted thermosuit with exposed silver seam-work and modular pockets. Charcoal Kevlar-weave jacket, worn and patched. Combat boots with reinforced ankle supports. Dark, purposeful, nothing decorative.
distinguishing_marks: Fine silver scarring along both temples where neural interface harness threads beneath skin, visible when hair is pulled back
Thin, precise burn scar running from left collarbone to mid-sternum — corporate incident, never explained
Raised rectangular implant scars on inside of both wrists where move-by-wire control nodes integrate with motor cortex
Small, deliberate tattoo on right inner forearm: circuit-board pattern in black ink, marking transition from corpo to freelance
